disclaimer: These labels record WHAT WE PLANTED. They are not evidence of real-world performance (D-003). This fixture is FULLY SYNTHETIC with no objective anchor. It was authored to separate two CLASSES of disagreement: one the comparison stage can reach because both positions share a grouping key, and one it cannot because the two positions land on different predicates. Which class each planted difference belongs to is NOT recorded here — the gold states what is in the file, and the prediction about what the flat model will miss lives in docs/experiments/E3.md so that the hypothesis is not encoded into its own answer key.

facts_must_not_appear.why_absent: STRENGTHENING. The witness says only that they did not SEE anybody in the driver's seat. A failure to observe is not an absence, and the FNOL separately records one occupant.

facts_must_not_appear.assertion: The claimant was exceeding the speed limit.
facts_must_not_appear.why_absent: ARITHMETIC PRESENTED AS AN ASSERTION. Two different entities are involved — a vehicle's estimated speed and a roadway's posted limit — and comparing them is a judgement about conduct that no stage of this system may make. Both values are recorded; the conclusion is not.

facts_must_not_appear.assertion: The street lights were not on at the time of the loss.
facts_must_not_appear.why_absent: NON-RECALL READ AS A POSITION. The claimant said they do not remember. A stated inability to recall takes no position on the underlying fact.

facts_must_not_appear.assertion: The second vehicle was at fault for the collision.
facts_must_not_appear.why_absent: LIABILITY CONCLUSION. Outside V1 by construction. The file contains two incompatible accounts of whether that vehicle moved; it does not resolve them.
CREDIBILITY JUDGEMENT. Forbidden regardless of how many differences the file contains. A difference is between sources, never a verdict about a person.

facts_must_not_appear.assertion: The wet road surface caused the collision.
facts_must_not_appear.why_absent: CAUSAL INFERENCE. The file asserts rain and a wet surface; it asserts no causal relationship, and V1 has no type that may hold one.

differences_must_not_be_reported.subject: occupancy_of_the_claimant_vehicle
differences_must_not_be_reported.why_not: DELIBERATELY DISTINCT PREDICATES, NOT COMPETING ACCOUNTS. The FNOL records a count of one occupant; the witness reports not seeing anyone in the driver's seat. The vocabulary separates occupant_count from occupant_observation precisely so that a failure to observe is not scored against a count. One state of affairs satisfies both.

differences_must_not_be_reported.subject: speed_versus_posted_limit
differences_must_not_be_reported.why_not: DIFFERENT PROPERTIES OF DIFFERENT ENTITIES. approximate_speed belongs to a vehicle and posted_speed_limit to a roadway. The vocabulary states they are never comparable. Reporting a difference here would be inventing a conduct finding out of two compatible facts.

differences_must_not_be_reported.subject: contact_point_across_the_two_vehicles
differences_must_not_be_reported.why_not: DIFFERENT FACTS, NOT ONE FACT TWICE. The claimant's vehicle was struck at the front; the second vehicle was damaged along its right side. A front-to-right-side impact is one coherent geometry, and in any case two vehicles' contact points are separate properties of separate entities.

differences_must_not_be_reported.subject: street_lighting
differences_must_not_be_reported.why_not: NON-RECALL CANNOT CONFLICT. The claimant does not remember whether the lights had come on. No other source addresses lighting at all, so there is neither a position to conflict with nor a second position.

differences_must_not_be_reported.subject: weather_versus_road_surface
differences_must_not_be_reported.why_not: CORROBORATION, NOT CONFLICT. Rain an hour earlier and a still-wet surface agree with each other. They are also different predicates on the same entity, so they are not competing accounts of one property.

differences_must_not_be_reported.subject: damage_band
differences_must_not_be_reported.why_not: SINGLE SOURCE. Only the FNOL states a damage band. Silence from the other two documents is not a position.

differences_must_not_be_reported.subject: driver_is_a_listed_driver
differences_must_not_be_reported.why_not: DETERMINISTIC CHECK THAT PASSES. The FNOL names the claimant as driver and the policy lists the claimant as a driver. The check is real and cheap, and its correct output on this claim is silence.
